hook: Your boat in India's Andaman Sea passes a live volcano.
title: India's Only Active Volcano Sits at Sea
description:
Barren Island in India's Andaman Sea is the only confirmed active volcano in South Asia. Boats can pass it and see smoke rising over black volcanic rock. It sits alone in the middle of the sea.

#Shorts #Geography #India
